title: Security Telemetry Event
description: One event per chunk per request. Identifiers and decisions — NEVER content. Copying confidential chunk text into observability systems builds a second, unaudited corpus outside every control you just built.

policy_version.description: The replay key. Without it, a decision made under v41 cannot be explained after you ship v42.

decision_source.description: Which mechanism decided. Distinguishes a fresh decision from a stale one.

entered_llm_context.description: The field that makes UCE computable separately from URR — the difference between a retrieval anomaly and a boundary violation.
